coverageContext: Complete UK Biobank basal-cell-carcinoma-weighted research model evaluated against the broader keratinocyte-cancer endpoint in 18,933 Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging participants of European ancestry. This is not a separately validated basal-cell-only personal prediction. Study odds ratios included age, sex and ancestry covariates; GA computes only the genetic component. Not a skin examination, lesion classification, UV-exposure measurement, screening schedule or calibrated cancer probability.

Han Chinese TPMI research model for coded noninfectious or unspecified uveitis, evaluated in 128 cases and16,930 controls. Published AUROC includes sex, age, array and ancestry covariates, not GA genetics alone. EUR ranks are withheld. Not an assessment of current eye inflammation, infection exclusion, inflammatory subtype, vision loss, diagnosis or treatment need.
